annotations.title: Ask about an aircraft for sale

description: Send a buyer's interest in an aircraft for sale (with reference), or a request to find one (without reference, describing it in question), to the Altivo Jets aircraft sales desk, which contacts the buyer by email or phone with the asking price, specs and records. Call it only when the buyer asks to be contacted, after confirming their name and email. Nothing is reserved, offered or agreed.

email.description: Buyer's email; the desk replies here.

phone.description: Buyer's phone with country code (optional, speeds up the reply).

question.description: What the buyer wants to know, or the aircraft to find (type, budget, year, location).

reference.description: The aircraft's reference from search_aircraft_for_sale, e.g. "2006-cessna-citation-cj3-525-0111", or its altivojets.com page address.

name: request_aircraft_info
